In summary, our research is concerned with

the identification, cloning and characterization of genes involved in the synthesis and assembly of the type IV pilus of Pseudomonad aeruginosa 2244, a clinical isolate from a patient with cystic fibrosis.
the biosynthesis of a bacterial cell surface structure, the type IV pilus.
the identification, characterization and regulation of genes encoding proteins involved in the biosynthesis of Pseudomonad pilins and their glycosylation.
